title: About This Guide

blocks.text: Thank you very much for reading this guide! I got the inspiration to make this guide because I wanted there to be a single place where all the information for Persona 4 Golden could be found. As such, there is a lot of information that was found by other GameFAQs users, who are found in the Copyright and Special Thanks section. Without their information and findings, this guide would not exist, so go support them any way you can. This guide will only be covering information for Persona 4 Golden. While differences between Persona 3, Persona 4, and Persona 4 Golden are explored in depth in the About Persona 4 Golden section, they will not be talked about much in the rest of the guide. If you have any questions or concerns about this guide or anything in Persona 4 Golden, feel free to message me on GameFAQs, or email me at Hurricanehaon@gmail.com. I hope you enjoy this guide and Persona 4 Golden!
